title: plantago atrata subsp. carpatica
intro: Plantago atrata subsp. carpatica, commonly known as Alpine Plantain, is a plant species in the Plantaginaceae family. It is a perennial herb native to mountainous regions of Europe and Asia, with various medicinal properties. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to the alleviation of symptoms associated with respiratory issues and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Plantain include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, immune system modulation, and anti-inflammatory responses.
